```{r setup}
library(bioRtools)
```

`cor_analysis()` returns a tidy table of pairwise correlations and p-values.

```{r}
data(test_data)

cor_result <- cor_analysis(
  data_1 = test_data[, c("Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width")],
  data_2 = test_data[, c("Petal.Length", "Petal.Width")],
  method = "pearson"
)

head(cor_result)
```
